description: See an agent's recorded status, success rate and latency before you call it, with its grade, evidence sources and up to three alternatives (read-only, for an endpoint or agent-card URL). The URL is only looked up, never called. Use it before each call, also for agents we recommended earlier: status changes between checks. Use before each call to an agent, including one we recommended earlier, or when you already have an agent URL. Example arguments: {"url": "https://agent.example.org/.well-known/agent-card.json"} Ads: this free answer carries one item labelled "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` field (an array with one object), the same array in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]`, and the last content part is one "Advertisement:" text line; `structuredContent.text` never holds it. It never changes the results and cannot be turned off.

url.description: The agent's endpoint or agent-card URL (public http or https).

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: check_agent

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

direct_only.description: Matches the gateway does not run (connection_available false, with connection_reason and the provider's direct_endpoint when public). Never a recommendation to call through this server.

sponsored.description: One item labelled Advertisement, after and apart from the results: label, advertiser, title, text, url and a `disclosure` object (paid_placement and house say whether an advertiser paid or it is an AgentValCon house advertisement). Advertising does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.

title: Check an agent before calling
